blocks.title: Air cargo clearance priorities
blocks.body: JKIA air cargo is usually chosen because time matters, but speed only helps if the customs file is ready. Kenya Tradex helps importers line up the Airway Bill, invoice, packing list, permits, consignee details and release instructions before a small document issue consumes the time saved by air freight.

Airway Bill, invoice, packing list, permits and importer details should align with the shipment and customs declaration.
Pharma, perishables, electronics, parts and other regulated goods may require additional handling, inspection or agency coordination.

faq.question: What documents are needed for JKIA air cargo clearance?
faq.answer: Typical documents include Airway Bill, commercial invoice, packing list, importer details, permits where applicable and any agency or carrier references needed for cargo release.

faq.question: What cargo commonly needs urgent JKIA clearance?
faq.answer: Common urgent cargo includes spare parts, medical and pharma shipments, samples, courier cargo, ecommerce consignments, perishables, electronics and time-sensitive business supplies.

faq.question: What can delay air cargo release at JKIA?
faq.answer: Delays often come from missing permits, mismatched Airway Bill and invoice details, unclear cargo descriptions, valuation questions, inspection selection, payment timing or late consignee authorization.
